name: Jokei Kazoku III ~Himitsu~
source:
In this erotic game, you play a man sent to convince four beautiful young heiresses to relinquish all claim to their father's fortune. Use your sexual prowess to win them over and accomplish your hidden agenda.

[From [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/PCG0312]J-List[/url]]
